iterations.observed: The numeric silhouette gate passed, but the unpanelled front and 3/4 reads were still too egg-like and lacked a stable temple side wall.
iterations.changes: Built the initial 27x48 multi-section superellipse loft from front width and averaged side-depth samples; excluded front-mask ear-pod contamination.
iterations.result: Front IoU 0.926523; worst side IoU 0.873852. Numeric pass, visual hold.

iterations.observed: Reference overlays showed the crown/jaw taper was sound, while the measured ear region still made the mid-body look circular.
iterations.changes: Added measured-profile temple and side-depth plateaus and increased crown/mid/lower superellipse exponents without returning to ellipsoid radii.
iterations.result: Front IoU 0.927858; worst side IoU 0.874787. Numeric pass and the reference-consistent master was accepted for part extraction.

iterations.observed: The first 21-part build was rejected: faceplate nearly rectangular, cell-selected edges visibly stepped, eyes buried, ear covers button-like, and neck entry too shelf-like.
iterations.changes: Raised cage sampling to 55x96, narrowed the faceplate, separated panel bands, moved eye geometry outside the faceplate, added stepped embedded ear covers and cyan emitters, and tightened the neck ribbon.
iterations.result: The 23-part hierarchy and power-helmet divisions became readable, but selected-cell faceplate and crown borders still failed the edge-quality gate.

iterations.observed: Higher sampling reduced but did not remove staircase borders; bevel miters also produced spikes on the open curved faceplate rim.
iterations.changes: Replaced cell selection for Faceplate and CrownFront with analytic continuous UV patches, variable brow/lower boundaries, and removed the faceplate rim bevel while retaining thickness.
iterations.result: Smooth reference-shaped brow, lower taper, side wrap, U-frame, and embedded ear/side structure passed the main visual gate.

iterations.scope: final shading, fit, reference-empty, and eye-seat repair
iterations.observed: Remaining checks found mild faceplate highlight breakup, an 8.3 mm InnerShell nose penetration, Blender 5.2 Image Empty API incompatibility, and eyes sitting too proud of the armor.
iterations.changes: Added one controlled faceplate subdivision level, formed a localized inner nose support cavity, tuned top/side/rear clearances, created true Image Empties, and seated housing/lenses at approximately 3.2/2.2 mm from the sampled faceplate surface.
iterations.result: Final front IoU 0.955171, worst side IoU 0.886771, front/side mean errors 0.9881%/2.7685%; minimum proxy clearance 4.705 mm with no sampled penetration. Visual and numeric gates passed.
